examples.english: “But it so happened that the Shoemaker, who had taken Minucha into his home upon her orphanhood on the condition that, when the time came, he would be the first to have her as the only way to compensate for the costs of her upbringing and maintenance, began to grow insistent and reminded the Shoemaker’s Wife of their agreement. But since she would not consent and instead obstructed him, and since Minucha’s breasts were growing and firming in an alarming manner, the Shoemaker sought to claim his due one of those afternoons (…).”
examples.ref: 1972, Torrente Ballester, Gonzalo, La saga/fuga de J. B:
examples.text: «Pero sucedió que el Zapatero, que había admitido a Minucha en su casa en la ocasión de su orfandad a condición de que, llegado el momento, la pasaría el primero por la piedra como única manera de resarcirse de los gastos de educación y mantenencia, empezó a ponerse pesado y a recordar el trato a la Zapatera; y como esta no se decidía, sino que, al revés, lo estorbaba, y como las tetas de Minucha crecían y endurecían de manera alarmante, el Zapatero quiso cobrarse una de aquellas tardes (…)».
examples.translation: “But it so happened that the Shoemaker, who had taken Minucha into his home upon her orphanhood on the condition that, when the time came, he would be the first to have her as the only way to compensate for the costs of her upbringing and maintenance, began to grow insistent and reminded the Shoemaker’s Wife of their agreement. But since she would not consent and instead obstructed him, and since Minucha’s breasts were growing and firming in an alarming manner, the Shoemaker sought to claim his due one of those afternoons (…).”

examples.english: “The house in which the gentleman now resides is spacious and sturdy. It has a hallway with a large lantern in the center, wide chambers, and a courtyard. The pantry is stocked with all the provisions and delicacies that the most refined gourmand could desire, and on the walls of the salon, in panoplies, hang the finest and most beautiful swords ever forged in Toledo.”
examples.text: «La casa en que ahora habita el caballero es ancha y recia. Tiene un zaguán con un farolón en el centro, anchas cámaras y un patio. La despensa se halla provista de cuantas mantenencias y golosinas pueda apetecer el más delicado lamiznero, y en las paredes del salón, en panoplias, se ven las más finas y bellas espadas que hayan salido de las forjas toledanas».
